verdict.rationale: Insomnia's docs say it integrates with external vault service providers and retrieves secret values automatically when requests are sent, which keeps credentials out of shared environment files (insomnia-docs-24). The docs also say Insomnia's sync servers cannot read sensitive project data (insomnia-docs-34). The evidence is a single-line vault claim, though, and nothing describes masked or secret-typed variables. Missing for 10: documentation of masked or secret environment variables, a list of supported vault providers, an explanation of how secrets are kept out of Git Sync or Cloud Sync files, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
